_comment: Snippets for .8ba audio assets — see docs/project/audio.md.
Each body is checked in packages/compiler/test/snippets.test.mjs.

Instrument.description: A synth instrument with waveform, polyphony, volume (0..15) and decay (frames; 0 holds).

Sample with fallback.description: A WAV/FLAC sample with a synth fallback if the file is missing.

Song with pattern.description: A short song with one pattern, track, and two rows.

One-shot song.description: A song that plays once: 3 frames a row, a note held two rows, a rest, a second note.
